testDefinitions.displayName: Identification of Microcrystalline Cellulose (reaction with iodinated zinc chloride)
testDefinitions.notes: About 10 mg dispersed in 2 mL iodinated zinc chloride solution on watch-glass; substance becomes violet-blue (BP 2024 / USP 2023).

testDefinitions.displayName: Identification of Vitamin K1 (conformity with assay)
testDefinitions.notes: Identified by conformity with the assay procedure (cerimetric titration).

sources.source: Vitamin K1__SM- Vitamin K1 new + Micro.txt:29

testDefinitions.titrationEquivalencyFactorDerivation: 0.00861 g Vitamin K per mL of 0.1 M titrant / 0.1 = 86.1 mg/mmol
testDefinitions.notes: 0.15 g sample in 15 mL glacial acetic acid + 15 mL 2 M HCl + 1 g Zn powder; stand 60 min in dark, filter, 0.1 mL ferroin solution; titrate with 0.1 M ceric ammonium sulfate to endpoint. F = 86.1 mg/mmol (0.00861 g/mL / 0.1 M). Formula in STM has LOD correction but spec sheet row has resultBasis PercentAsIs (5.0%).

testDefinitions.displayName: Identification of Magnesium (reaction of magnesium, Test C)
testDefinitions.notes: 1 mL solution S + 1 mL dilute ammonia R1 (white precipitate forms, dissolves on 1 mL ammonium chloride); add 1 mL 120 g/L disodium hydrogen phosphate (white crystalline precipitate forms). (BP 2025).

sources.source: Magnesium Stearate__Magnesium Stearate - SM.txt:32

testDefinitions.displayName: Freezing point of fatty acids (Magnesium Stearate ID Test B)
testDefinitions.notes: Determined on residue from ether layer of solution S, dried at 100-105 °C; freezing point recorded on calibrated thermometer in Nessler tube (minimum 53 °C). (BP Appendix V B; BP 2025).

sources.source: Magnesium Stearate__Magnesium Stearate - SM.txt:32

testDefinitions.displayName: Acid value of fatty acids (Magnesium Stearate ID Test B)
testDefinitions.notes: 0.200 g residue in 25 mL neutralized ethanol:petroleum ether (1:1), 0.5 mL phenolphthalein R1, titrate with 0.1 M KOH or NaOH. Formula IA = 5.611 x n / m (195-210). Decision 2026-11-04: Measurement test, analyst enters the calculated acid value.

sources.source: Magnesium Stearate__Magnesium Stearate - SM.txt:32

testDefinitions.notes: 1.0 g boiled in 20 mL CO2-free water for 1 min, cool, filter. To 10 mL filtrate add 0.05 mL bromothymol blue R4; NMT 0.05 mL of 0.1 M HCl or 0.1 M NaOH to change colour. Decision 2026-11-04: Measurement test, analyst enters titrant volume in mL.

sources.source: Magnesium Stearate__Magnesium Stearate - SM.txt:33

testDefinitions.displayName: Assay of Magnesium Stearate (complexometric back titration)
testDefinitions.titrationEquivalencyFactorDerivation: 2.431 mg Mg per mL of 0.1 M edetate / 0.1 = 24.31 mg/mmol
testDefinitions.notes: 0.500 g in 50 mL 1:1 ethanol:butanol + 5 mL conc ammonia + 3 mL ammonium chloride buffer pH 10.0 + 30.0 mL 0.1 M disodium edetate + mordant black 11 triturate; heat 45-50 °C, titrate excess with 0.1 M zinc sulfate (blue to violet). Blank titration performed. Dried-substance row.

sources.source: Magnesium Stearate__Magnesium Stearate - SM.txt:52

testDefinitions.displayName: Identification of D-Alpha Tocopheryl Succinate (colour reaction)
testDefinitions.notes: Sample solution in absolute alcohol + 2 mL 70% nitric acid, heat at 75 °C for 15 min; bright red or orange colour develops. (USP 2024).

sources.source: D-Alpha Tocopherol Succinate__STM for Alpha tocopherol Succinate.txt:29

testDefinitions.notes: 1.0 g dissolved in 25 mL ethanol, 0.5 mL phenolphthalein, titrate with 0.10 N NaOH until pink colour persists. Specification: 18.0 to 19.3 mL of 0.10 N NaOH. Decision 2026-11-04: Measurement test, analyst enters titrant volume in mL.

testDefinitions.displayName: Identification of Liquid Sorbitol (appearance and viscosity)
testDefinitions.notes: Visual check: clear, colourless or almost colourless, syrupy liquid. (BP 2025).

testDefinitions.displayName: Identification of Liquid Sorbitol (optical rotation with borate)
testDefinitions.notes: 7.0 g + 40 mL water + 6.4 g disodium tetraborate, stand 1 h, dilute to 50.0 mL, measure on calibrated polarimeter (+1.5° to +3.5°). (BP 2025).

sources.source: Liquid Sorbitol__Liquid Sorbitol - SM.txt:31

testDefinitions.notes: 5.0 g + 6 mL water + 20 mL cupri-citric solution, boil 3 min, cool, add 100 mL 2.4% acetic acid + 20.0 mL 0.025 M iodine + 25 mL dilute HCl, titrate with 0.05 M sodium thiosulfate (starch). NLT 12.8 mL required (max 0.2% glucose equivalent). Decision 2026-11-04: Measurement test, analyst enters calculated % glucose equivalent.

sources.source: Liquid Sorbitol__Liquid Sorbitol - SM.txt:34

testDefinitions.notes: 6.0 g + 35 mL water + 40 mL 1 M HCl, reflux 4 h, cool, neutralize with NaOH (bromothymol blue R1), dilute to 100.0 mL. 3.0 mL aliquot reacted with cupri-citric and back-titrated with 0.05 M thiosulfate. NLT 8.0 mL required (max 9.3% glucose equivalent). Decision 2026-11-04: Measurement test, analyst enters calculated % glucose equivalent.
